purpose: Standing instructions for Meta Muse to distribute finished 3000 Studios music promo videos without recreating or altering the approved master unless requested.

queue.source: Google Drive > promo > READY TO POST - MUSE
queue.receipts: Google Drive > promo > POST RECEIPTS - MUSE

eligibility: Use only completed music promo, Short, Reel, teaser, visualizer, or music-video clip files that belong to 3000 Studios.
Do not post the same finished asset twice to the same account unless the user explicitly asks for a repost.
Do not invent a missing video. If the source file cannot be opened, report it as missing and continue with the next ready item.
workflow: Read the READY TO POST - MUSE queue before creating anything new.
For each ready asset, identify the song title and use 3000 Studios as the artist name.
Prepare a concise platform-native caption with the song title, a clear listen/follow/subscribe call to action, and only relevant hashtags.
Use the connected official 3000 Studios social account for each platform.
Before a public publish action, present the final asset, caption, destination account, and platform for approval when the platform or Muse requires approval.
After a successful publish, save the live URL or platform receipt in POST RECEIPTS - MUSE and move the source asset to POSTED - MUSE.
If a platform fails, leave the source in READY TO POST - MUSE and record the failure instead of silently skipping it.

tiktok.instructions: Use the site's authorized TikTok Promo Studio for the MP4. Direct public posting is used only after TikTok approves video.publish; until then, send the finished promo to the TikTok inbox as a draft and return the receipt.

instagram.instructions: Post eligible vertical promos as Reels using the connected official 3000 Studios Instagram account.

facebook.instructions: Post eligible vertical promos as Reels/video posts using the connected official 3000 Studios Facebook account.

youtube.instructions: Upload eligible vertical promos to the official 3000 Studios YouTube account as Shorts when appropriate; preserve the finished master and avoid duplicate uploads.

threads.instructions: Use a compatible teaser/video post when the connected account supports the asset format; otherwise publish the promo link and matching caption.

captionRules.cta: Prefer listen, watch, follow, or subscribe calls to action.
captionRules.hashtags: Use a small set of relevant song, genre, artist, and discovery hashtags; never stuff unrelated trending tags.

safety: Never buy, fake, automate, or misrepresent views, likes, comments, subscribers, follows, or engagement.
Never replace a finished promo with an AI-regenerated version unless the user asks for a new edit.
Never expose account credentials, tokens, cookies, API keys, or private Drive links in captions or public posts.
